sloka: कृत अभिषेकैः तैः न्यस्ता वल्कलाः पादपेषु इह ।अद्य अपि न विशुष्यन्ति प्रदेशे रघुनंदन ॥३-७४-२६॥
transliteration: kṛta abhiṣekaiḥ taiḥ nyastā valkalāḥ pādapeṣu iha ।adya api na viśuṣyanti pradeśe raghunaṁdana ॥3-74-26॥

translations.english: O delight of the Raghus look at the bark robes spread on the trees to dry after their bathing which are still wet.
translations.hindi: महात्मा वानर ऋत्षराज के पुत्र महाबलवान्‌ सुग्रीव उसी पर रहते हैं
